generate_proto_from_source: generate a _pb2.py file from a .proto source file using the Protocol Compiler
generate_unittest_protos: generate all unittest proto files for protobuf internal and external test suites
build_protobuf_python_package: build the protobuf Python package by generating descriptor protos and running setuptools build
clean_generated_files: clean generated _pb2.py .pyc .so and .o files from the protobuf code tree
run_conformance_tests: run the protobuf Python conformance test suite against the C++ implementation
